title: Java Software Engineer
location: София Hybrid Комбиниран модел на работа, позволяващ на служителите съчетание между работа в офиса и работа от разстояние.
description:
We are a leading trading platform that is expanding to the four corners of the globe. Our top-rated products have won prestigious industry awards for their cutting-edge technology and seamless client experience. We deliver only the best, so we are always in search of the best people to join our ever-growing talent team.
We are currently growing our Backend Team and looking for great Engineers with an interest in trading to join us! Our Engineering team plays a pivotal role in ensuring the robustness, speed, and security of our product. Dedicated to enhancing performance, providing a best-in-class user experience, ensuring compliance, and safeguarding data, the team’s efforts directly impact our ability to offer clients a seamless and secure trading journey.
We believe great engineering talent not only delivers excellent code, but also lives our values. We are looking for someone who is eager to go fast, willing to innovate and grow, who knows how to listen, respect and support, strives to exceed client expectations, and takes full ownership to achieve real results.
Core responsibilities:
Design and build scalable, low-latency, and high-performance backend services
Develop distributed and asynchronous systems ensuring reliability and fault tolerance
Optimise performance across JVM, databases, caching, and networking layers
Apply security best practices in handling client PII and financial transactions
Use event-driven architectures and modern messaging solutions (e.g. Kafka)
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align architecture with business needs
Maintain high code quality through testing, code reviews, and CI/CD practices
Leverage AI tools to accelerate development, testing, and delivery
What you will need: Experience & domain knowledge:
Proven experience in FinTech, Banking, or related financial domains
Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture and the client–server model
Ability to design and maintain scalable, low-latency, high-performance systems
Solid knowledge of concurrency, multithreading, and asynchronous programming
Awareness of security best practices in handling PII and financial transactions
Basic understanding of network protocols and troubleshooting
Experience working in a product-led fast-paced environment as a team player
Technical skills:
Java and Spring: Advanced knowledge of Java Core technologies and the Spring framework
Data Mastery: Proficiency with SQL databases, ensuring optimal performance, structure, and replication
Concurrency & Async programming: advanced understanding and hands-on experience in asynchronous programming methods.
Events streaming: Understanding of the event driven architecture (Kafka or similar solutions).
Operational Proficiency: Understanding and hands-on experience with Ops activities, Kubernetes, pipelines, Fit Flow and modern CI/CD patterns and strategies
AI tools: ability to effectively use AI technologies in engineering work e.g. applying AI for coding assistance, debugging, testing, documentation, and optimisation of workflows
Soft skills:
Communication: Effective communication skills, especially with teams responsible for security, operations and product
Analytical thinking: Ability to tackle and investigate complicated problems and convert it to the task
Adaptability to Rapid Changes: Demonstrated capability to adjust to quick technological shifts and evolving business requirements
Ownership and Accountability: Readiness to take ownership of tasks, issues as well as demonstrate accountability of the results and outcome
Nice to have:
Performance: Knowledge of JVM performance optimization practices
No-SQL: Experience working with no-SQL databases is a big plus
In-memory storage: Strong knowledge of in-memory cache solutions
What you will get in return:
Competitive salary and annual performance-based bonus
Generous annual leave policy
Health insurance and pension fund, with additional benefits depending on location
Hybrid working model (3 days from office) or fully remote across the country of employment
Workation policy (30 days remote from anywhere in the world)
Two additional paid days per year dedicated to volunteering
Be a key player at the forefront of the digital assets movement, propelling your career to new heights! Join a dynamic and rapidly expanding company that values and rewards talent, initiative, and creativity. Work alongside one of the most brilliant teams in the industry.

title: Senior Web Developer
location: София Hybrid Комбиниран модел на работа, позволяващ на служителите съчетание между работа в офиса и работа от разстояние.
description:
Driving the next generation of wealth.
Digital assets are redefining how wealth is created, used, and transferred. Since 2018 at Nexo, we have been building the future model of financial wealth – dynamic, accessible, and designed for a new generation of forward-thinking investors.
But technology alone doesn’t drive progress. People do.
We are a team of builders, strategists, analysts, creatives, and operators united by a shared mindset: advancement. We move fast, think long term, and take ownership. We challenge ideas, not people. We value clarity over noise and impact over optics.
What makes Nexo different?
We shape industry trends. We rethink how wealth works and build solutions that reflect that belief.
That requires a certain kind of person.
You will thrive here when you think independently and act decisively, take ownership without waiting for permission, and care deeply about quality, long-term value, and disciplined execution. The people who succeed at Nexo bring analytical depth, sound judgment, and resilience – but also curiosity and the drive to keep improving.
This is an environment for people who want to lead, create, and elevate what already exists. If building what’s next excites you, you’ll feel at home at Nexo.
Your role:
You will build and maintain nexo.com, our primary marketing platform reaching millions of potential clients worldwide.
You will work with React 19, Next.js 16, TypeScript, Payload CMS, MongoDB, Docker, and Figma.
You will translate designs into responsive, accessible interfaces across modern devices and browsers with Tailwind CSS.
You will maintain the component library and design system for consistency and scalability with Storybook.
You will ship conversion-focused features and track them to drive measurable business growth.
You will optimize for performance, Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, and cost reduction.
You own it, you ship it, you measure it.
What makes you stand out:
5+ years of Software Engineering experience with Node.js.
Expert proficiency in Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
Strong experience with MongoDB or AWS DocumentDB.
Solid command of modern CSS and responsive design.
Deep knowledge of web performance: code splitting, lazy loading, image optimization, and caching.
Understanding of technical SEO: structured data, meta tags, sitemaps, and rendering strategies.
Ability to use AI efficiently to ship/refactor faster, without compromises in the end-result.
Experience with A/B testing, feature flags, and analytics instrumentation.
Solid understanding of Git, CI/CD, and modern deployment practices.
Ability to create Minimal Reproducible Examples of issues.
Presence in the open-source community; contributing to projects.
Leadership and ability to balance code quality with deadlines.
Self-starter with focus on tangible results and problem solving.
Curiosity and desire to learn, improve, and dig deep.
Passion for simplicity; knowing how to avoid over-engineering.
Resilience in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
Desired (but not essential):
Experience with AWS resource management and deployment.
Experience with Cloudflare and networking.
Experience with software internationalization and localization.
Knowledge of Google Analytics 4 and tracking implementation.
Familiarity with infrastructure as code and Terraform.
Understanding of fintech, crypto, or complex B2C digital products.
Eye for aesthetics, animation, UX, and design.
Some experience with PHP.
Benefits:
Competitive and rewarding remuneration package.
Annual performance-based bonuses.
Comprehensive Learning Hub for continuous growth.
Hybrid work model: primarily office-based with scheduled home office flexibility.
A dynamic and inspiring environment with cutting-edge projects.
Career development opportunities in a global leader driving the next generation of wealth.
Customizable personal benefits package.
Wellness benefits include additional health insurance, all-access sports cards, team-wide sports activities, standing desks, and blue light glasses.
Free parking with a designated space, free electric bikes, and public transportation cards.
Fresh fruits, snacks, and a well-stocked office kitchen.
Regular department team buildings and company-wide team buildings.

title: Senior .NET Developer
description:
Xebia
is a global AI-first, digital transformation, and engineering partner. With over 25 years of experience and a team of 5,000 professionals across 16 countries, we help organizations design and build scalable products, platforms, and data-driven solutions.
We specialize in Artificial Intelligence, Data and Cloud, Intelligent Automation, and Digital Products, combining deep technical expertise with a strong focus on engineering excellence and a people-first culture.
In the CEE region, we’re a team of nearly 1,000 experts delivering modern applications, data platforms, and AI solutions for clients such as Millennium, ING, Play, Edenred, Arabian Drilling, FedEx, Leroy Merlin, Truecaller, Volotea, Schmitz Cargobull, and many, many more. We work with leading technologies including AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, and Snowflake, and combine strong engineering culture with a consulting mindset and a continuous focus on growth and knowledge sharing.
About project:
We are looking for a
.NET Developer
to join a project delivered for our international client operating in the rail transportation and asset-leasing industry. The client is a well-established global organization supporting complex business operations through modern digital solutions.
The project focuses on migrating and modernizing a business-critical enterprise platform, with the first phase establishing a reusable technical foundation and migrating an initial set of business modules. A key priority is maintaining existing functionality and complex business rules while introducing targeted improvements in usability, automation, performance, observability, and security.
You will work in an international Scrum team, collaborating closely with engineers, business stakeholders, testers, and domain experts. The project offers an opportunity to work on modern application development while tackling the challenges of enterprise migration, complex integrations, data dependencies, and business-critical systems.
You will be:
developing and maintaining backend applications using C# and .NET,
building and integrating REST APIs and ASP.NET Core WebAPI services,
migrating existing business functionality while maintaining functional parity and business rules,
contributing to a reusable application platform with shared components and common development patterns,
working with PostgreSQL and application data models, including data migration and system dependencies,
integrating the platform with enterprise systems and other business applications,
analyzing existing processes and translating complex business requirements into reliable technical solutions,
contributing to automated testing using xUnit and applying TDD principles where appropriate,
troubleshooting applications and contributing to improvements in performance, observability, security, and maintainability,
participating in code reviews, technical discussions, refinement, planning, and other Scrum activities,
collaborating closely with business stakeholders and domain experts to understand existing functionality and business rules,
supporting incremental releases, user acceptance testing, and post-release stabilization,
using AI-powered development assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor to improve productivity and software delivery,
depending on seniority, taking ownership of technical topics, proposing improvements, and supporting less experienced team members.
Your profile:
strong knowledge of C# and .NET,
practical experience with ASP.NET Core and WebAPI,
experience designing and developing REST APIs and backend services,
practical experience with relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL,
experience with Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core,
solid understanding of object-oriented programming, clean code, and software design principles,
experience with automated testing and TDD, preferably using xUnit,
experience with Git and standard software development workflows,
ability to understand existing systems, business rules, dependencies, and technical constraints,
good problem-solving and analytical skills,
ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, business stakeholders, and domain experts,
practical experience using AI-powered development assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor,
work from the European Union region and a valid work permit are required
.
Nice to have:
experience working on enterprise application migration or modernization projects,
experience with AWS and cloud-based application environments,
experience with Docker,
experience with Terraform or infrastructure-as-code,
experience with Azure DevOps,
familiarity with frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript,
experience with automated frontend or end-to-end testing using Vitest or Playwright,
experience applying GenAI in a more structured way within the SDLC, including defined workflows, prompt patterns, or tool integrations embedded into daily work.
interest in and familiarity with emerging AI-driven practices (e.g. agent-based workflows, automation patterns, AI-augmented development), with a willingness to explore and experiment beyond standard approaches.

title: Senior Java Developer
location: София Hybrid Комбиниран модел на работа, позволяващ на служителите съчетание между работа в офиса и работа от разстояние.
description:
About us
Partake is a B2B fintech company providing an end-to-end lending platform as a service. Its core product, F-PaaS (Financing Platform as a Service), covers the entire lending lifecycle, from loan origination to loan management, and operates as a secure, multi-tenant cloud platform.
Partake serves a diverse client base, ranging from non-bank financial institutions to large banks, enabling them to establish and manage comprehensive financing services on a single platform. Through F-PaaS, clients can unlock new revenue streams and deliver end-to-end financial services to their customers from day one.
Responsibilities and main job tasks:
Design, develop and maintain high performance, distributed, business critical applications in the FinTech field.
Build product features on top of LLMs (retrieval, tool calling, structured output) and make them predictable enough to run inside a regulated financial system.
Work with AI coding agents daily and stay accountable for what they produce. You review it, you test it, your name is on the merge.
Evaluate new tools, models and approaches, and tell the difference between something that works in production and something that only demos well.
Solve challenging problems, while working in a highly dynamic and technologically driven environment.
Own your code from development to production, including what happens to it after release.
Requirements:
4+ years of Java design and development (server side), with recent work on Java 17 or 21: records, sealed types, pattern matching, virtual threads.
Knowledge and experience in microservices and distributed systems. Designing and consuming RESTful APIs, with OpenAPI as the contract.

is a global alternative investment management firm focused on pursuing outperformance for sophisticated clients via our Systematic, Discretionary and Solutions offerings. Powered by talent and advanced technology, our single and multi-manager investment strategies are underpinned by deep research and span public and private markets, across all major asset classes, with a significant focus on alternatives. Man Group takes a partnership approach to working with clients, establishing deep connections and creating tailored solutions to meet their investment goals and those of the millions of retirees and savers they represent.
Headquartered in London, we manage $253.6 billion* and operate across multiple offices globally. Man Group plc is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker EMG.LN and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index. Further information can be found at www.man.com
At Man Group, we respect your privacy and we are committed to protecting and safeguarding your Personal Data. We have developed policies and processes which are designed to provide for the security and integrity of your Personal Data. We are committed to Processing your Personal Data fairly and lawfully, and being open and transparent about such Processing. For further information on how we process your data, please see the privacy notice for applicants here.
* As at 30 June 2026
The Role
We’re seeking a
Staff Python Engineer
to provide technical leadership across our technology organisation, working on high-impact challenges spanning systematic trading, quantitative research, our petabyte-scale data platform, and AI solutions.
This is a senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who sets technical direction, not just delivers against it. You will shape architecture across team boundaries, raise the engineering bar through hands-on mentorship and review, and act as a trusted technical partner to engineering leadership, researchers, and traders. You’ll be given significant autonomy to identify and drive the highest-leverage technical initiatives, while remaining deeply hands-on in design and code.
Role Responsibilities
Own architectural direction for critical systems, making build-vs-buy and long-term design decisions that span multiple teams and years, not just sprints
Design and build scalable backend systems, APIs, and distributed compute applications that underpin trading and research infrastructure, with a focus on performance, resilience, and observability at scale
Build and evolve high-performance data pipelines for petabyte-scale financial datasets, working across timeseries, SQL, and NoSQL databases
Act as a technical escalation point and thought partner for engineers, researchers, and platform teams, translating ambiguous or conflicting requirements into coherent technical strategy
Lead by example on engineering craft: set standards for testing, code review, and production readiness, and raise the bar through mentorship of engineers at all levels
Drive cross-team technical initiatives from proposal through delivery, including proofs of concept, migrations, and platform-wide improvements
Participate in production support rotations and contribute to incident response and postmortems for the most critical systems
Champion the adoption of AI-assisted development tools and agentic engineering practices across the team, and help define how the organisation uses them responsibly at scale
Our Technology
You’ll work in a modern, Linux-based infrastructure where Python is the primary development language, utilising the full scientific stack including pandas, numpy, scipy, and scikit-learn. A key component of our data infrastructure is ArcticDB (https://arcticdb.io/), our internally developed DataFrame database that you’ll use and help evolve. We maintain a dynamic technology landscape, continuously evaluating and adopting new tools and libraries that enhance our capabilities. man.com/technology
Our Sofia Office
This role sits within our growing Sofia office, one of Man Technology’s fastest-expanding engineering hubs outside London. We recently moved into a newly built, purpose-designed office in the city as part of our long-term investment in the team here. Beyond day-to-day delivery, our Sofia engineers help raise Man Group’s profile as a technology employer locally – engaging with the Bulgarian tech community through university partnerships, hackathons, and local meetups.
Key Competencies
Essential
8+ years’ professional software development experience, with deep expertise in Python or another object-oriented language and demonstrated ability to become an expert-level Python engineer quickly
Track record of owning architecture and technical direction for systems used in production at scale, beyond the scope of a single team
Strong academic record with coursework focused on mathematical and computing content, e.g. Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or Physics
Deep experience with best practices for testing, monitoring, deployment, and operating mission-critical production systems
Experience with distributed systems, orchestration, and large-scale performance optimisation
Proficient on Linux platforms with strong command of Git and modern engineering workflows
Deep knowledge of one or more relevant database technologies, spanning relational (e.g. Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL), NoSQL/document (e.g. MongoDB), or timeseries (e.g. ArcticDB) systems
Demonstrated experience designing for and working with large, complex data sets, both structured and unstructured
Proven ability to influence technical direction without formal authority, and to align stakeholders across teams with differing priorities
Experience mentoring engineers and elevating the technical capability of a team
Experience integrating tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or custom agentic workflows into a team’s SDLC
Advantageous
Deep understanding of the Python scientific stack (pandas, numpy, scipy, scikit-learn)
Familiarity with related data platforms such as monitoring and metrics (e.g. Prometheus, InfluxDB), search and analytics (e.g. Elasticsearch), streaming (e.g. Kafka), or big data and distributed compute (e.g. Hadoop, Spark)
Knowledge of modern data engineering practices including ETL tooling, distributed storage and processing, and data warehousing
Significant contributions to open-source projects
Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), including applying them to engineering workflows or products
Experience in financial services, trading, or quantitative research environments
Experience defining or influencing engineering standards, guilds, or communities of practice across an organisation
Why Man Group?
Set technical direction on problems at the true cutting edge of technology and finance
Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and investment professionals – and shape how they work
Entrepreneurial, innovation-driven culture with small, agile teams and high autonomy
Significant influence over architecture and engineering practice, without giving up hands-on technical work
Direct impact on investment strategies managing billions in assets
Benefits
Modern office located in the OfficeX campus with easy access to transport and amenities.
Hybrid working model
Competitive compensation package
25 days holiday allowance
Premium Health insurance
Employee Assistance program
Referral Bonus
Additional days off for long service and volunteering
Multisport card
Opportunities for professional development including internal tech talks
Conference attendance, and engagement with the open-source community
Inclusion, Work-Life Balance and Benefits at Man Group
You’ll thrive in our working environment that champions equality of opportunity. Your unique perspective will contribute to our success, joining a workplace where inclusion is fundamental and deeply embedded in our culture and values. Through our external and internal initiatives, partnerships and programmes, you’ll find opportunities to grow, develop your talents, and help foster an inclusive environment for all across our firm and industry. Learn more at
www.man.com/diversity
.
You’ll have opportunities to make a difference through our charitable and global initiatives, while advancing your career through professional development, and with flexible working arrangements available too. Like all our people, you’ll receive two annual ‘Mankind’ days of paid leave for community volunteering.
Our comprehensive benefits package includes competitive holiday entitlements, pension/401k, life and long-term disability coverage, group sick pay, enhanced parental leave and long-service leave. Depending on your location, you may also enjoy additional benefits such as private medical coverage, discounted gym membership options and pet insurance.
Equal Employment Opportunity Policy
Man Group provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants and all employees without regard to race, color, creed, national origin, ancestry, religion, disability, sex, gender identity and expression, marital status, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, age or any other legally protected category or status in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.

[email protected]

The client you’ll work with:
WeShop
is a community-owned shopping platform with a social twist. You’ll contribute to maintaining and improving the existing product, optimising performance, and developing new functionality as the platform continues to grow.
A particularly interesting part of the role will be the opportunity to get involved in building a new WeShop web application from scratch. You’ll be joining at an early stage and will have the chance to contribute to how the application is designed and structured, as well as taking an active role in its development from the ground up.
Alongside this, you’ll continue working with the APIs used by WeShop’s mobile applications, the processes and integrations connecting the platform with external services, and the internal tools used by WeShop’s teams.
You’ll work closely with mobile engineers, testers and other specialists across the business, contributing to technical discussions and helping turn product ideas and requirements into reliable, maintainable solutions. Expert-level knowledge of Node.js and TypeScript
Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL, someone comfortable working with Linux and Docker containers

Confident using Git and Gitflow

Enjoys solving complex problems and can accurately assess the wider impact of a change

Can prioritise tasks effectively based on business needs
Comfortable communicating openly and consistently within the team and across the wider business

Front-end knowledge, ideally with React

Exposure to DevOps and system administration

Experience with conversational AI context handling

Experience developing and scaling production applications, including API design and job queuing.

title: Technology Summer Internship
description:
Man Group
is a global alternative investment management firm focused on pursuing outperformance for sophisticated clients via our Systematic, Discretionary and Solutions offerings. Powered by talent and advanced technology, our single and multi-manager investment strategies are underpinned by deep research and span public and private markets, across all major asset classes, with a significant focus on alternatives. Man Group takes a partnership approach to working with clients, establishing deep connections and creating tailored solutions to meet their investment goals and those of the millions of retirees and savers they represent.
Headquartered in London, we manage $253.6 billion* and operate across multiple offices globally. Man Group plc is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker EMG.LN and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index. Further information can be found at
www.man.com

here
.

About the Programme
Our Technology Internship programme invites you to spend
12 weeks
fully embedded in one of our teams, tackling impactful projects that drive technological advancement and deliver meaningful business impact. You’ll receive formal training and comprehensive support from a dedicated buddy and mentor who will guide your development and help you navigate the organisation. We also host knowledge sharing sessions and intern-specific events to help you build a broader understanding of Man Group and the wider financial services industry.
Your projects will span cutting-edge technology domains such as software development, DevOps and data engineering, with the opportunity to enhance our quantitative investment platform, integrate new datasets, extend our execution and order management systems, and contribute to our core technology platform. You will build a deep understanding of our business and the financial markets by working closely with teams across Portfolio Management, Trading, Risk, Responsible Investment, Operations and more, and you’ll have the chance to present your project to senior management.
Candidates who demonstrate strong performance may be offered a full-time position on our Technology Foundation Programme, our graduate scheme for launching exceptional technology careers at Man Group.

Join us as an intern and you’ll be part of a team that builds and runs the platform powering Man’s hedge funds.
Requirements:
Experience working with any of the following programming or scripting languages: Python, Java, C#.Net or C++ or demonstrable understanding of how an enterprise infrastructure functions.
A genuine passion for technology – please include links to relevant work such as Github repostries, previous internships or Hackathon projects on your application.
Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics or a related technical discipline (desired but not necessary). If you are excited about the role and can pass our tech test, we encourage you to apply.
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
Exceptional troubleshooting skills
Candidates should be in the penultimate year of their master’s or bachelor’s degree.
Application Process
Application Window:
16th September– 30th October 2026
CV Screen:
We’ll review your application and contact you by email to confirm whether you’re progressing to the next stage. Due to high application volumes, there may be a short wait, but we’ll respond as soon as possible.
Online Test:
Technical homework assignment that should take no longer than one hour.
Technical Interview:
One-hour technical interview with an engineer from the team to assess your coding skills.
Final Interview:
30 minutes with one of our technology managers to assess your suitability for the programme, either at our office in Sofia or via video call.
Note
: We take your technical interests and preferences into consideration when determining which team you will intern in.
Programme Date:
21st June 2027 –10th September 2027
Inclusion, Work-Life Balance and Benefits at Man Group
You’ll thrive in our working environment that champions equality of opportunity. Your unique perspective will contribute to our success, joining a workplace where inclusion is fundamental and deeply embedded in our culture and values. Through our external and internal initiatives, partnerships and programmes, you’ll find opportunities to grow, develop your talents, and help foster an inclusive environment for all across our firm and industry. .

title: Senior Software Engineer, EU Own Acquiring
description:
SumUp enables businesses to get paid easily, process orders quickly, sell online instantly and manage their money more efficiently. We create the tools businesses need to make their business and their customer experience thrive.
The payments processing platform, consisting of other sub-platforms, has powered SumUp’s global business for more than 10 years now. It’s developed in Sofia by the Payments Tribe, composed of several teams (squads). Each squad is cross-functional, autonomous and co-located, working on its part of the platform end-to-end.
Now, we are taking a major step forward in our Payments journey: building our own acquiring capability in Europe.
About the team
You’ll join a growing Payments team working on the next generation of SumUp’s payment capabilities. The team is building and evolving foundational systems that will improve the reliability, scalability and flexibility of our products.
This is an opportunity to work on a new and important area of our platform, where your technical decisions will help shape how SumUp supports millions of small businesses around the world. You’ll have the chance to contribute from an early stage, solve complex engineering challenges and see the impact of your work in real-world payment experiences.
About the role
As a Senior Software Engineer in our own acquiring team, you’ll help build and evolve the systems that power SumUp’s payment experiences. You’ll work on foundational, greenfield components that improve the reliability and scalability of our platform while enabling us to deliver new payment capabilities to small businesses around the world. This is an opportunity to influence architectural decisions, shape engineering practices and work on highly critical infrastructure from the ground up.
What you’ll do:
Design and build core acquiring capabilities, including authorisation, clearing and settlement processing.
Develop the APIs, data models and services that will form the foundation of our acquiring platform.
Build reporting, back-office and operational tools for a reliable day-to-day acquiring operation.
Ensure our systems meet card-scheme, security and compliance requirements.
Create strong observability, monitoring and incident-response foundations for an always-on payments platform.
Work closely with teams across Processing, Reconciliation, Risk, Compliance, Finance and Treasury.
Contribute to architecture discussions and make sound technical decisions in an ambiguous, evolving domain.
Take ownership of medium-to-large technical initiatives that span multiple teams.
Identify and help prioritise technical debt, operational risks and opportunities to improve the platform.
Support the growth of the team through mentoring, code reviews and shaping testing and on-call practices.
You’ll be great for this role if you have:
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on experience with Go.
Experience building and consuming APIs in production environments.
Understanding of software architecture, design principles, data modelling, API design and SOLID principles.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases; experience with PostgreSQL and Kafka is valuable.
Practical experience with Docker, AWS and Kubernetes.
A DevOps mindset and an interest in building, operating and improving the systems you own.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate complex issues methodically.
A collaborative approach and openness to feedback.
A strong sense of ownership and accountability for your work.
It would be a great advantage if you have:
Experience with Elixir or another functional programming language.
Experience with AWS Prometheus and Grafana.
Experience in fintech, payments or another regulated domain.
Knowledge of card schemes, acquiring, authorisation, clearing or settlement.
You do not need to know the acquiring domain already. What matters is your technical foundation, curiosity and willingness to learn. You will work alongside colleagues who are building this capability together, with plenty of room to ask questions and make an impact.
Why you should join SumUp:
Make an impact on a global scale – our systems serve millions of merchants
Learn from experienced engineers while working on complex, real-world problems
Be part of a tech-agnostic team that uses the right tools for the job
Collaborate with SumUppers worldwide on large-scale fintech products used by millions, based in our Sofia office (office-first setup).
Access a €2,000 annual L&D budget to attend conferences or advance your career through education.
Enjoy 25 days of paid leave (increasing with tenure), plus paid vacations for special occasions and a 1-month sabbatical every 3 years.
Benefit from extra perks like health and life insurance, co-sponsored Multisport cards, childbirth/adoption bonuses, discounts, a referral program, 100 EUR monthly food vouchers, 40 EUR flexible benefits, and more.
About SumUp
We believe in the everyday hero.
Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we create powerful, easy-to-use financial solutions to help them run their businesses. With a founder’s mentality and a ‘team-first’ attitude, our diverse teams across Europe, South America and the United States work together to ensure that the small business owners we partner with can be successful doing what they love.
SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.
SumUp will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate.
Job Application Tip
We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Back-End Developer

description:
Балев Корпорейшън ЕООД изгражда малък вътрешен екип, който да разработи от нулата нова B2B платформа за поръчки, интегрирана със SAP. Имаме готова функционална спецификация, нямаме написан код.
Търсим Back-End разработчик за гр. Варна, който да започне при първа възможност и да изгради ядрото на платформата: заявки, наличности, цени и финансови документи.
Защо тази роля е различна?
• Проект от нулата, без наследен код.
• Готова спецификация и бизнесът на една ръка разстояние.
• Малък екип с технически лийд.
• Вътрешен продукт с дълъг живот, не проект до предаване.
По какво ще работиш?
• Двупосочна интеграция със SAP: продукти, наличности, цени, клиенти, заявки, фактури.
• Бизнес логика за заявки: наличности, ценови листи, ДДС, методи на плащане и кредитен лимит.
• Ролеви достъп, известия по имейл и уеб, генериране на PDF и Excel.
• Логване и проследимост на грешки при обмена със SAP.
Основни отговорности:
• Проектиране на модела на данните и REST API заедно с техническия лийд.
• Изграждане на интеграционния слой със SAP.
• Разработка на бизнес логиката на платформата.
• Code review, автоматизирани тестове, документация на API.
Изисквания:
• Минимум 3 години опит като Back-End разработчик с Java и Spring Boot.
• Опит с REST API и интеграции към външни системи.
• Уверена работа с PostgreSQL.
• Опит със Spring Security и познаване на принципите на сигурността.
• Чист код и умения за работа в екип.
Предимство е: опит със SAP или друга ERP система, B2B платформи или фактуриране.
Технологии (Back-End):
• Java 21+, Spring Boot, Spring Security
• Spring Data JPA, QueryDSL, PostgreSQL
• Springdoc OpenAPI (Swagger)
• PDF Generation, Apache POI (Excel)
• Lombok, Spring Boot Test
• Redis, Docker, Git
Какво предлагаме?
• Трудов договор.
• Отлично заплащане.
• Много добър социален пакет.
• Работа в спокойна среда.
Ако желаете да се присъедините към нашия екип, моля, изпратете своята актуална автобиография със снимка.
Само одобрените кандидати ще бъдат поканени на интервю.

description:

You’ll join a growing practice that runs application support and operations across 20+ clients, covering Java, .NET, Python, and TypeScript/Node.js stacks. Your primary assignment will be two Java applications for a Swiss federal regulatory authority, but you’ll also contribute to other engagements as the team and portfolio evolve.
We’re building an AI-first operations model. If you’re the kind of engineer who builds scripts and automations to eliminate repetitive work, and who reaches for AI tools before doing things manually, you’ll fit right in.
Your first assignment involves two Java applications with very different stacks: one modern cloud-native system on Java 25 / Spring Boot 4, one legacy Java EE monolith in maintenance mode. Over time, you may rotate into Python, .NET, or TypeScript/Node.js engagements depending on team needs and your profile.
This is not greenfield development, but it’s not just keeping the lights on either.
Beyond day-to-day support, these engagements include product evolution: new features, regulatory adaptations, and system improvements driven by real user needs. Apply security patches and manage CVE remediation.
Coordinate releases with infrastructure partners and the client.
Maintain and extend automated test suites.
Document operational procedures and runbooks.
Participate in on-call rotation.
Build domain knowledge in client-specific business domains.
Use AI tools actively in your workflow: code generation, log analysis, incident triage, test creation, documentation.
Identify and implement automation opportunities that reduce manual operational effort.
Contribute to building our AI-assisted operations model.
What We’re Looking For
Must have:
3+ years of professional Java development (any version from 8 to 25).
Experience with at least one of: Spring Boot or Java EE / Jakarta EE.
Relational database experience (PostgreSQL or Oracle).
Comfortable reading and maintaining code you didn’t write.
Experience working in application support, maintenance, or operations (not just greenfield).
Active use of AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) in your daily work.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Good written English. German is a significant plus for client communication, but not a requirement.
Strong plus:
Second language: Python, C#/.NET, or TypeScript/Node.js (you may rotate into projects on these stacks).
Spring Boot 3+ or 4 (dependency injection, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, scheduled tasks).
PostgreSQL with JSONB or non-relational data patterns.
Java EE / WebLogic administration and deployment.
Oracle database (PL/SQL, DB scripts, change-controlled procedures).
Observability and monitoring experience (setting up logging, alerting, dashboards, defining SLIs/SLOs).
CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar).
Container orchestration (Kubernetes/AKS, Helm, Istio).
Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform).
Frontend experience (Vue.js, React, or Angular) for full-stack delivery.
Experience in regulated industries (pharma, medtech, public sector, finance).
DDD, onion/hexagonal architecture, OpenAPI-first design.
Experience building automations, scripts, or bots that reduce manual ops work.
Familiarity with AI/ML APIs, LLM integration, or building AI-assisted workflows.
What We Offer:
Long-term, stable engagement across a portfolio of Swiss clients.
Work on systems that directly impact public health, insurance, and infrastructure in Switzerland.
Small team with high autonomy.
AI-first culture: we invest in AI tooling and expect you to shape how we use it.
Rotation opportunities across Java, Python, and .NET engagements.
Structured knowledge transfer and domain training during onboarding.
If you feel you don’t meet all the requirements, we are still happy to get to know you, learn more about your ambitions and ideas and look forward to receiving your application!
We welcome people from all backgrounds, regardless of their gender, personality, national origin, race, religion, colour, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability or veteran status.

designing and developing production-grade full-stack web applications and enterprise software,
providing hands-on technical leadership and helping establish engineering patterns, standards, and best practices,

supporting modern CI/CD, testing, observability, and production engineering practices.
Your profile:
10+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally across modern full-stack web applications and enterprise products,
strong hands-on expertise in TypeScript and JavaScript, with significant production experience in React and backend runtimes such as Node.js or Deno,
solid experience with PostgreSQL, including data modelling, querying, performance, and application integration, as well as Supabase or comparable cloud-native / Backend-as-a-Service platforms, including authentication and data access controls such as RLS,
strong experience designing and integrating REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven solutions, and third-party SaaS platforms, including OAuth 2.0 and secure API integrations,
strong understanding of modern authentication, authorisation, permissions, and secure application design,
experience with modern frontend development patterns, automated testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels, and responsive application design,
strong understanding of CI/CD, Git-based workflows, and modern SDLC practices, with experience deploying and supporting production applications with a focus on observability, performance, reliability, security, and operational readiness,
excellent problem-solving and debugging skills, particularly across complex full-stack and third-party integration scenarios,
strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, architecture, and platform teams,
automation-first and product-focused mindset, comfortable working with emerging technologies while maintaining the engineering discipline required to operate software at enterprise scale,
practical experience using AI-powered assistants (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to improve productivity, quality, or decision-making in software delivery.
Work from the European Union region and a work permit are required
.

experience using LLM APIs, AI SDKs, or developing AI-enabled applications,
familiarity with the Vercel ecosystem, TanStack Query, React Router, Tailwind CSS, or shadcn/Radix,
experience working with developer platforms such as GitHub or Jira,
experience applying GenAI in a more structured way within the SDLC, including defined workflows, prompt patterns, or tool integrations embedded into daily work,

title: Team Lead
description:
About Us
:
Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook, casino and retail via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.
Where you Fit In:
As a Team Lead, you report to the Engineering Manager and operate within a cross-functional squad alongside a Product Owner, Lead Engineer, QA, NOC, Performance and IT Operations. You partner closely with the Product Owner on execution, and with the Engineering Manager and Lead Engineer to ensure the team is set up for long-term success.
Who are You?
As a Team Manager, you enable team effectiveness and sustainable delivery from the engineering management side. You ensure engineering capacity, risks, quality practices, and cross-team dependencies are managed effectively and collaborate with Product Owners to ensure sprint/iteration execution and backlog outcomes. You partner closely with the Engineering Manager and Lead Engineer to maintain delivery health, team cohesion, and operational readiness.
The impact you will have:
Engineering delivery support (with PO owning sprint execution)
Partner with the Product Owner to ensure engineering work is well-shaped: feasibility, dependencies, sequencing risks, and acceptance criteria quality.
Support predictable delivery by managing engineering-side coordination: WIP discipline, capacity alignment, and escalation of blockers.
Maintain a clear view of delivery health (cycle time, defect trends, operational load, reliability signals) and drive corrective actions with EM/Lead.
People leadership & team health (within EM’s org)
Run regular 1:1s focused on engagement, feedback, and growth; coordinate with the Engineering Manager on performance topics and development plans.
Improve onboarding, mentoring structure, knowledge sharing, and team rituals that increase cohesion and execution quality.
Contribute to hiring -interview participation, role calibration, onboarding plans.
Cross-functional coordination
Act as the engineering-side coordination point across Product Owner, QA, NOC, Performance, Architects/Principals, and other engineering teams.
Manage cross-team dependencies, integration readiness, and communication cadence, ensuring no surprises at release time.
Release management cooperation with IT Operations
Work closely with IT Operations on release execution and change management process: environment constraints, change windows, approvals, access needs, and rollback/validation protocols.
Ensure release readiness practices are consistent: checklists, go/no-go criteria, comms plans, and post-release verification.
Operational excellence & incident follow-ups
Partner with IT Operations and the Lead Engineer to reduce operational toil (automation, process simplification, better tooling).
Coordinate with the incident team to ensure follow-ups happen -ownership assignment, tracking to completion, and recurring-issue elimination.
Ensure runbooks, operational docs, service READMEs, and service ownership practices are maintained and discoverable.
What we’re looking for:
3+ years in engineering leadership / team coordination roles (Team Lead, Delivery Lead, Engineering Team Coordinator, or similar).
Demonstrated success working in cross-functional product teams where Product/Delivery owns planning cadence.
Strong stakeholder management with Product Owners and engineering counterparts.
Good technical fluency (enough to challenge assumptions, understand risk, and drive quality/operational practices), ideally with exposure to Java/service delivery environments.
Strong facilitation, conflict management, and escalation judgement.
Metrics literacy: can interpret delivery, quality, and operational indicators and drive improvements.
Prior hands-on development background (Java/services) or deep SDLC governance experience.
On-call / incident management exposure.
Experience in environments with strict release controls or regulatory constraints.
Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
About Man Group
Man Group is a global alternative investment management firm focused on pursuing outperformance for sophisticated clients via our Systematic, Discretionary and Solutions offerings. Powered by talent and advanced technology, our single and multi-manager investment strategies are underpinned by deep research and span public and private markets, across all major asset classes, with a significant focus on alternatives. Man Group takes a partnership approach to working with clients, establishing deep connections and creating tailored solutions to meet their investment goals and those of the millions of retirees and savers they represent.
Headquartered in London, we manage $227.6 billion* and operate across multiple offices globally. Man Group plc is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker EMG.LN and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index. Further information can be found at www.man.com
* As at 31 December 2025
Purpose of the Role
We’re seeking Senior Python Engineers to join various teams across our technology organisation, working on diverse challenges spanning systematic trading, quantitative research, a petabyte-scale data platform, and AI solutions.
The role offers the opportunity to collaborate with and learn alongside highly skilled engineers whilst developing core technical and financial services knowledge. You will work with cutting-edge technologies and systems that power critical areas of Man Group’s business.
Role Responsibilities
Design and maintain scalable backend systems and APIs that support quantitative research and trading infrastructure
Develop distributed compute applications, optmise performance, and implement monitoring and observability tooling to ensure system reliability
Build high-performance data pipelines for processing large-scale financial datasets using timeseries, SQL, and NoSQL databases
Partner with engineers, researchers, and platform teams to translate complex requirements into technical solutions that integrate with Man Group’s technology estate
Participate in production support rotations and contribute to architecture decisions, code reviews, and engineering best practices across the team
You should have the enthusiasm for leveraging AI development tools to accelerate delivery and driving their adoption across the team.
Our Technology
You’ll work in a modern, Linux-based infrastructure where Python is the primary development language, utilising the full scientific stack including pandas, numpy, scipy, and scikit-learn. A key component of our data infrastructure is ArcticDB (https://arcticdb.io/), our internally developed DataFrame database that you’ll use extensively. We maintain a dynamic technology landscape, continuously evaluating and adopting new tools and libraries that enhance our capabilities. man.com/technology
Key Competencies
Required
Minimum 5 years’ professional software development experience in any object-oriented language. Python experience is preferred, though we are open to candidates proficient in other object-oriented languages who are willing to learn Python.
Strong academic record with coursework focused on mathematical and computing content e.g. Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or Science
Experience developing mission-critical production systems, with knowledge of best practices for testing, monitoring, and deployment
Proficient on Linux platforms and strong understanding of Git
Strong knowledge of one or more relevant database technologies e.g. MS SQL, Postgres, or MongoDB
Demonstrated experience working with large data sets, both structured and unstructured
Ability to work independently and gather requirements from stakeholders
Embracing agentic engineering — willingness and ability to work effectively with AI -assisted development tools as part of daily workflow
Advantageous
Deep understanding of the Python scientific stack (pandas, numpy, scipy, scikit-learn)
Familiarity with distributed systems and orchestration
Knowledge of modern data engineering practices including data pipeline & ETL tools, distributed storage & processing and data warehousing
Contributions to open-source projects
Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs)
Experience mentoring junior team members and managing projects
Why Man Group?
Work on challenging problems at the cutting edge of technology and finance
Collaborate with world-class engineers, researchers, and investment professionals
Receive on-the-job training to develop and succeed at the firm
Entrepreneurial, innovation-driven culture
Small, agile teams with high autonomy
Opportunity to make a real impact on investment strategies managing billions in assets
Benefits
Modern office located in the OfficeX campus with easy access to transport and amenities.
Hybrid working model
Competitive compensation package
25 days holiday allowance
Premium Health insurance
Employee Assistance program
Referral Bonus
Additional days off for long service and volunteering
Multisport card
Opportunities for professional development including internal tech talks
Conference attendance, and engagement with the open-source community

KBC Global Services is the engine behind KBC Group – a leading bank-insurance group with over 45,000 talented employees serving more than 12 million clients across Europe.
The SSC Automation & Tooling team, as part of KBC Global Services – Bulgaria branch, supports Group-wide credit risk modelling and validation activities through high-quality software solutions. As expectations from the European Central Bank (ECB) and internal control functions continue to grow, there is a strong need to centralise, automate, and standardise these processes. In the Automation and Tooling team, this translates into developing solutions that enforce consistency and enable efficient, audit-ready workflows across the full modelling and validation lifecycle.
In this role, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of tools supporting credit risk modelling and validation processes. You will design and implement new functionalities, enhance existing applications, and ensure high-quality, well-documented code. • Understanding of software development lifecycle and testing

• Ability to present complex topics in a clear and structured way to both technical and non-technical audiences
• Continuous improvement mindset focused on optimising processes and applications
• Eagerness to learn and grow

• Fluent English (written and spoken)

title: Associate, Software Developer Full Stack
company: EBRD - The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development
location: София Hybrid Комбиниран модел на работа, позволяващ на служителите съчетание между работа в офиса и работа от разстояние.
description:
Following this link you are expressing an interest in this job listing. Any application for consideration will need to be made through the EBRD website
.
About the platform
The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) is building a next-generation Client-Led Procurement (CLP) platform hosted on Microsoft Azure. The platform digitises procurement workflows across bankers (internal), clients, and external participants through four dedicated Angular portals backed by a microservices backend on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). The architecture follows a strict Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) pattern: an API Management ingress layer, persona-specific BFF composer services, and independently deployable domain services.
What You’ll Do
As an Associate Full Stack Developer you will contribute to both the frontend Angular portals and the backend Spring Boot microservices that power the CLP platform. You will work within a cross-functional Agile team, taking features from specification through design, implementation, testing, and deployment on AKS. The role spans the full stack across all services on the platform.
Key responsabilities
Design, implement, and maintain backend domain microservices using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
Build and enhance Angular single-page applications for the Internal, Client, Participant, and Public portals.
Implement and document RESTful APIs following OpenAPI/Swagger standards; contribute to API-first design reviews.
Work with the Azure data tier: Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Blob Storage, and Cosmos DB.
Write and maintain Liquibase database migrations; ensure schema safety across environments.
Author unit, integration, and contract tests (JUnit 5, Spring Boot Test, Pact) and maintain coverage gates.
Containerise services with Docker and support deployment on AKS via Helm charts and CI/CD pipelines.
Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and threat-modelling sessions.
Contribute to observability: structured logging (Logback/Logstash), distributed tracing (Application Insights), and SLO dashboards.
Operate within EBRD engineering standards including SonarQube quality gates, SAST/DAST scanning, and branch policies.
Need to Have — Your Essentials
Backend — Java / Spring Boot
Java 21+:
proficient in modern Java features — records, sealed classes, pattern matching, virtual threads
Spring Boot 3.x+:
REST controllers, JPA/Hibernate, validation, actuator, autoconfiguration
RESTful API design:
OpenAPI 3 / Swagger; resource modelling, versioning, error contracts
Azure Database for PostgreSQL:
JDBC, JPA mappings, PostgreSQL SQL dialect, index-aware query design
Multi-module Gradle builds:
buildSrc convention plugins, version catalogues (libs.versions.toml)
Testing:
JUnit 5, Spring Boot Test (@SpringBootTest, @DataJpaTest), Mockito; targeting 80 %+ coverage
Git:
branching strategies, pull-request-based workflow, code review
Frontend — Angular / TypeScript
Angular 21:
components, services, reactive forms, RxJS, signals, Angular Router, lazy loading
TypeScript:
strict mode, interfaces, generics, decorators
REST API consumption:
HttpClient, error handling, interceptors, environment configuration
HTML5 / CSS3:
responsive layouts, WCAG accessibility awareness
State management:
NgRx or equivalent reactive state pattern
Cloud & Platform
Microsoft Azure:
working knowledge of AKS, Azure Storage, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Key Vault, and Managed Identity concepts
Docker:
Dockerfile authoring, multi-stage builds, container image best practices
CI/CD:
experience with any major pipeline tool (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins); automated build → test → deploy flow
Observability basics:
structured logging, correlation IDs, health endpoints (Spring Actuator)
Architecture & Ways of Working
Microservices / SOA:
service decomposition, bounded contexts, API contracts between services
Security awareness:
OAuth 2.0 / OIDC fundamentals, token validation, least-privilege data access
Agile / Scrum:
sprint ceremonies, backlog refinement, Definition of Done
Code quality:
SOLID principles, clean code, peer review, static analysis
Nice to Have
The following skills are advantageous but not required at hire; you will develop many of them on the job.
Azure Platform (Advanced)
Azure Blob Storage — SAS token issuance, lifecycle policies, blob versioning
Azure Service Bus — AMQP messaging, topics/subscriptions, dead-letter queues, idempotent consumers
Azure API Management (APIM) — inbound/outbound policy authoring, JWT validation, rate limiting, CORS
Azure Entra ID / B2C — OIDC flows, custom policies, app roles, SCIM provisioning
Azure Application Insights / Monitor — distributed tracing, workbooks, alert rules
Azure Front Door / Application Gateway / WAF
Kubernetes & Infrastructure
AKS — pod lifecycle, HPA, PodDisruptionBudgets, namespace isolation
Helm — chart authoring, values overrides, release management
Workload Identity / Managed Identity on AKS — federated credential binding, RBAC scoping
Terraform — IaC for Azure resources, state management, module patterns
Data & Integration
Cosmos DB — SQL API or MongoDB API, partition key design, RU/s governance
Liquibase — changeset authoring, rollback strategies, multi-environment safety
GraphQL — schema design, query/mutation authoring, Apollo or Spring GraphQL
Azure Application Insights — distributed tracing, dependency tracking, performance monitoring, and alerting
Workflow & Quality Engineering
Camunda 7 or 8 — BPMN modelling, external task workers, compensation patterns
Contract testing — Pact (consumer-driven), provider verification in CI
SonarQube / Jacoco — quality gate configuration, branch/PR analysis
SAST / DAST / dependency scanning — integration in CI pipelines
Why You’ll Love This Role
Exposure to a modern, greenfield Azure-native platform built from first principles.
Work across the full stack — Angular portals, Spring Boot domain services, AKS, and Azure data services.

title: IT Consultant – Software development and Operations
location: София Hybrid Комбиниран модел на работа, позволяващ на служителите съчетание между работа в офиса и работа от разстояние.
description:
Tired of shipping code that becomes someone else’s problem the moment it hits production?
We’re looking for a software developer with a DevOps mindset — someone who wants to build things that hold up in production and have a real voice in technical decisions. In today’s IT landscape, teams that can own a service end-to-end — from writing the code to deploying, monitoring and operating it in production — are increasingly rare and increasingly valuable. Our dedicated engineering team is responsible for the design, build, and operations of cloud-native services, from backend development through CI/CD, containerization and orchestration, on modern cloud platforms.
Tech stack
You don’t have to know everything, but most of this should look familiar:
Backend development experience (Java with Spring Boot preferred)
Frontend development experience is a plus (JavaScript, TypeScript)
CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Crossplane)
Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure)
Interest in business workflow automation and orchestration — you’ll work with BPMN 2.0 and Camunda in real scenarios
How you work
You speak like a Consultant and play as part of a tech team
– you pro-actively propose solutions, outlining pros and cons and supporting the clients’ decision making process. You comfortably manage evolving client requirements and navigate the technical conversation towards practical solutions. You have no issue helping a teammate who’s stuck instead of letting issues sit and grow in silence.
You think in automation, not in „clicking around“
– when something repeats, your instinct is to turn it into a script or a pipeline step instead of relying on manual procedures.
You have a production mindset
– you care about how the system behaves in production; if you see strange behavior or risk, you raise it early and help find a sustainable fix, not just a quick patch.
You own things end-to-end
– combining backend development with a DevOps mindset is no longer a „nice to have“; it’s what lets you take a feature from code to production and be accountable for how it actually runs, without waiting on handoffs between teams.
What we offer
A voice in decisions, not „you just code“
You have direct contact with the architect and the technical lead and take part in the conversations about architecture, pipelines and tooling instead of just executing tasks passed down to you.
A rare and highly valuable combination of skills
Backend development and DevOps are increasingly merging in the industry, but pairing that with real hands-on BPMN/Camunda experience – including Camunda’s growing agentic orchestration capabilities – is still uncommon. You combine backend development, a DevOps mindset, and workflow/agentic orchestration tooling in real scenarios – a profile that will make you stand out on the market both now and in the future.
A small team, little bureaucracy
A team in an early phase, clear technical goals, short decision paths and a normal tone; the idea is to build stable systems, not to live in status meetings and reports.

title: Senior Backend Engineer – Storyfinding Team
location: София Hybrid Комбиниран модел на работа, позволяващ на служителите съчетание между работа в офиса и работа от разстояние.
description:
About Us
The Financial Times (FT) is one of the world’s leading business news and information organisations. We are recognised globally for our authority, integrity, and accuracy. We provide a broad range of essential services, including news, comment, data, and analysis, to a growing audience of internationally minded business people.
Here at the FT, gold-standard journalism is just the beginning. Our 500-people-strong Product & Tech team keeps us ahead of the ever-changing digital landscape by delivering cutting-edge products to over one million digital subscribers every day. Our plans for growth rely on a diverse, dedicated, and dynamic group of product, tech, delivery, and data specialists – everyone’s welcome in this friendly, forward-thinking team.
Storyfinding team
The Storyfinding team sits at the heart of innovation between the FT’s newsroom and technology. We collaborate closely with the Computational Journalism team to uncover and scale new ways of finding stories hidden in complex or unstructured data.
Our mission is to turn bespoke investigations into reusable tools and data products that empower more journalists to tell stories that otherwise would be untold. This is where engineering meets journalism — you can see the direct impact of your work on the FT’s homepage.
Since the team was formed, Storyfinding has helped uncover more than 10 exclusive stories, including
Europe builds for war as arms factories expand at triple speed
and
Prices for used Teslas drop in US and Britain
.
We are a cross-functional team of Software Engineers, Data Engineers, ML Ops Engineers, and Product Managers. We balance strong engineering practices with the fast-moving needs of the newsroom, delivering quickly while keeping our systems reliable, secure, and easy to evolve.
About the Role
Overview
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer 1 to play a key role in designing, building, and operating the backend systems and services that power Storyfinding’s investigative and editorial work.
This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role with a primary focus on backend software engineering. You will be responsible for designing and building robust backend systems and services, while also maintaining that data engineering is a key component of the work. You will contribute to and maintain critical data pipelines and data products, helping to establish patterns and standards that enable the team to scale its impact.
What You’ll Work On
Some example projects include:
Designing and operating data pipelines that ingest, clean, enrich, and model complex datasets for investigative reporting.
Building resilient, observable data workflows to support high-traffic and time-critical newsroom events such as elections or major economic announcements.
Developing shared data infrastructure and tooling that turns one-off investigations into reusable capabilities for the wider newsroom.
Working with unstructured and semi-structured data sources (documents, filings, scraped content, APIs) to create high-quality, queryable datasets.
Collaborating with journalists, product managers, and engineers to translate editorial questions into scalable data solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain scalable and resilient backend services, APIs, and infrastructure.
Ensure high standards of software quality through testing, documentation, observability, and security across all systems.
Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines and datasets in a cloud environment.
Work across OLTP and OLAP data stores to support both application-driven and analytical use cases.
Partner closely with journalists and other technical colleagues to shape data solutions that directly support storytelling.
Lead by example in engineering best practices, including code review, documentation, and pragmatic architectural decision-making.
Support and mentor more junior engineers through pairing, feedback, and knowledge sharing.
Identify areas where AI and new technologies can help in the newsroom and be able to propose ideas.
Actively participate in the process of requirements gathering and have the desire to have regular catch-ups with editors and journalists if that’s needed.
About You
We’re looking for someone curious, pragmatic, and motivated by impact. You enjoy working with messy real-world data, care deeply about reliability and clarity, and are comfortable operating in an environment where priorities can shift quickly around editorial deadlines.
Essential Skills
Strong experience as a backend engineer designing and building production-grade distributed systems and APIs in a cloud environment.
Excellent Python skills for developing backend services, system integration, and data processing.
Solid experience as a data engineer with a vital skill set in maintaining production data pipelines and using workflow orchestration tools like Apache Airflow.
Experience working with cloud platforms, particularly AWS.
Familiarity with modern engineering practices including version control, CI/CD, and automated testing.
The ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Interest in exploring new technologies and approaches related to AI and Agentic AI.
An interest in journalism, investigations, or using data to answer real-world questions.
Data Science (DS) experience or education is highly valuable for this role, as we leverage AI heavily for many of our use cases.
Desirable Skills
Strong SQL skills and experience designing and working with relational and analytical databases.
Experience with databases such as BigQuery, Redshift, PostgreSQL, SingleStore, or MongoDB.
Experience working with unstructured or semi-structured data at scale.
A solid understanding of data modelling, data architecture, and trade-offs between different storage and processing approaches.
Comfort contributing to backend software engineering tasks beyond pure data pipelines.
Exposure to building internal tools or lightweight user-facing applications.
Experience with building simple user interfaces or/and the desire to do so (e.g., using frameworks like Streamlit).
Characteristics We Value
Inquisitive and analytical, with strong problem-solving skills.
Pragmatic and delivery-focused, able to balance technical quality with newsroom deadlines.
Collaborative and generous with your knowledge.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving requirements.
A systems-level thinker who can see how individual pipelines and tools fit into a broader platform.
Motivated by learning and continuous improvement.
A collaborative team member who thrives in cross-functional environments and values collective success.
Our Technology
We don’t expect you to be an expert in everything. Our current stack includes:
Languages: Python, SQL
Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS
Data Pipelines & Orchestration: Apache Airflow, AWS ECS
Databases: BigQuery, Redshift, PostgreSQL, SingleStore, MongoDB
Version Control & CI/CD: GitHub, CircleCI
Frontend (small part of the role): Streamlit
This is a unique opportunity to use your technical skills to contribute to data journalism. You’ll be making content for the FT’s readership, using data to make news accessible, understandable, and impactful.
If this sounds like a role that aligns with your expertise and ambitions, we’d love to hear from you!
In Return, We Can Offer You
Annual bonus scheme
25 days paid leave
24/7 Employee Assistance Program
Life Insurance
Enhanced Parental Leave policy
Food Allowance
Multisport Card
Both in house and external training programs
Your own training dedicated budget (for conferences, courses etc.)
We currently operate a hybrid model which requires staff to work onsite 50% of the time, subject to role requirements & regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for all roles. We believe this balanced approach supports flexibility and protects our culture, making collaboration and communication easier, building stronger relationships and team cohesion, and supporting peer learning. We reserve discretion on reasonable notice to change this approach either generally or for specific individuals or teams.
Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion
We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.
Accessibility
We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.
Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email
[email protected]
and a member of our team will be happy to help.
Further information
At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may leverage AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.
Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process may be monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.
Please beware of fraudulent job postings and offers claiming to be from the Financial Times. All legitimate opportunities will direct you to apply through the official Financial Times careers site, and the FT will never ask for financial information, payments, or referrals to third parties during the hiring process. If you have any concerns about the legitimacy of a job posting or suspect any scam activity, please contact
[email protected]
.
