title: Software Engineer – Low-Latency Trading Systems
description:
About the opportunity
Talent Hunter is hiring a Software Engineer on behalf of our client, a proprietary trading company operating in the cryptocurrency and financial markets. The company develops its technology in-house, with a strong focus on high-performance, low-latency systems, real-time market data, and reliable trading infrastructure.
We are looking for a strong Software Engineer who enjoys solving technically challenging problems where performance, reliability, and precision are critical.
The role
You will work on the infrastructure responsible for receiving, processing, and delivering real-time market data to trading and research systems.
Your responsibilities will include:
Developing and maintaining real-time market data feed handlers
Working with exchange connectivity and different market data protocols
Handling sequencing, gap detection, recovery, reconnects, and out-of-order data
Working with real-time blockchain and DeFi data
Designing and optimizing low-latency systems
Working with CPU/cache-aware data structures, NUMA, hardware timestamps, and kernel-level optimizations
Building data capture, archival, and replay infrastructure
Implementing mechanisms to identify data quality issues, stale feeds, sequence anomalies, and other inconsistencies
Measuring and improving system performance, with a strong focus on tail latency
What we’re looking for
Proven experience with high-throughput and/or low-latency systems
Strong understanding of resilient systems and failure handling
Deep experience with Rust or modern C++
Strong knowledge of Linux internals and networking
Experience analyzing network traffic and packet captures
Experience optimizing system performance based on measurable results
Strong problem-solving skills and technical curiosity
Fluent English
Nice to have
Experience with financial market data or exchange protocols such as FIX, SBE/MDP3 or ITCH-style protocols
Experience with blockchain data or infrastructure
Knowledge of DeFi and AMM systems
Experience with prediction markets
Previous experience in HFT, trading, market data, or other real-time systems
Why consider this opportunity?
This is a highly technical engineering role for someone who enjoys working close to the systems level and solving challenging problems around performance, networking, real-time data, and reliability.
The environment is particularly suitable for engineers who are driven by difficult technical challenges and enjoy measuring, optimizing, and improving systems where every microsecond can matter.
If this sounds like the type of engineering challenge you would be interested in, we would be happy to share more details about the opportunity and the company during the recruitment process.

description:

We make smart devices and push the boundaries of the IoT sector every single day. Shelly is a strong company with a startup mindset — no bureaucracy, just bold ideas, creative problem-solving, and a team that genuinely loves what they do.
We turn every spark of an idea into a real product — from first concept to full production — and bring smart automation to over 3 million households around the world. From heating, lighting, appliances, curtains, and more — if it runs on electricity, chances are we can automate it. We’ve built over 100 smart devices (and counting!), and everything happens right here at our headquarters in Sofia.
Sounds exciting? Keep reading…
Senior Firmware Engineer — Shelly BLU
Your Role
This is a hands-on senior engineering role with real product ownership. You shape the shared firmware platform behind Shelly BLU and bring new battery-powered BLE and BLE+Zigbee devices from first project setup all the way to production — with a strong focus on low power, connectivity, security, and reliability.
What makes you a great fit:
You bring 5+ years of experience in embedded firmware development and strong modern C skills on ARM Cortex-M class SoCs, ideally in battery-powered, connected, or ultra-low-power products.
You are confident with RTOS-based systems and understand the full device lifecycle — timers, events, interrupts, deep sleep, retention, wake sources, watchdogs, and radio activity.
You know how to build scalable firmware on top of a shared, versioned SDK, using reusable components, clean extension points, and device-specific configuration instead of creating separate firmware forks.
You are fluent in BLE, including advertising, GATT servers, bonding, passkey pairing, connection lifecycle, OTA DFU, BTHome, and JSON-RPC over BLE.
You are comfortable integrating sensors and peripherals through GPIO, PWM, ADC, UART, I2C, timers, and similar interfaces.
You understand embedded security and persistent data design, including device identity, provisioning, encryption, signed and encrypted OTA, key lifecycle management, and non-volatile storage across firmware updates.
You work comfortably with Make, Linux shell, code generation, cross-compilation, containerized builds, vendor flashing/signing tools, and host-based or hardware integration testing.
Experience with Zigbee/ZCL, Python or another scripting language, embedded CI/CD, and hardware-in-the-loop automation is a strong advantage.
Your Responsibilities:
You evolve the shared Shelly BLU firmware SDK and keep it reusable, versioned, maintainable, and ready to support multiple devices.
You develop new Shelly BLU products end-to-end — from project setup and sensor integration to production-ready firmware and release.
You optimize the complete power and state lifecycle to achieve the right balance between responsiveness, radio performance, reliability, and long battery life.
You build and maintain the BLE functionality of our devices, including BTHome advertising, GATT services, pairing, connection management, JSON-RPC over BLE, and OTA updates.
You own secure device identity, provisioning, encryption, signed and encrypted firmware updates, factory reset, and reliable non-volatile configuration.
You build reproducible workflows for compiling, flashing, signing, provisioning, testing, and producing release images.
You create host-based and device-level tests, troubleshoot complex firmware, hardware, radio, power, and production issues, and drive them through to resolution.
You contribute to architecture and technical decisions and work closely with Hardware, QA, Product, and Manufacturing to turn ideas into reliable products at scale.

Work:
A welcoming, collaborative team
Meaningful products and services that people actually use and love.
Learning opportunities to sharpen your skills
Competitive salary + Performance bonuses
Modern office in a great location
Fun team buildings and company events
Lifestyle:
26 days of paid annual leave
Flexible working hours
Additional health insurance
Free access to all Shelly devices (yes, you can smarten up your whole home!)
Multisport Card
Fully sponsored yearly public transport card
Ready to join the Shelly Revolution?
Let’s build the future of smart living together.
Hit that Apply button — we can’t wait to meet you.

title: Full-stack Developer
description:

Role Overview
We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Developer with end-to-end proficiency across modern Angular frontend architecture and Node.js / TypeScript backend services. You will bridge client and server concerns – contributing to micro-frontend design on the frontend while architecting scalable, API-first backend services, preferably with NestJS, backed by PostgreSQL. This role requires a developer who can operate fluidly across the full stack, uphold engineering quality on both sides, and collaborate effectively with frontend specialists, backend engineers, and data teams.
Key Responsibilities
● Design and implement coherent end-to-end solutions spanning Angular micro-frontend shells and NestJS backend services, ensuring clean separation of concerns and consistent, well-documented API contracts.
● Build modular, high-performance Angular applications using standalone components and Signals as the primary reactivity model, with RxJS retained for async operations and HTTP stream orchestration. Contribute to or lead micro-frontend initiatives using Module Federation and Nx.
● Author OpenAPI/Swagger specifications as the primary design artifact before implementation, establishing the contract between frontend and backend. Implement RESTful services and streaming delivery patterns (SSE) derived from and validated against the agreed spec.
● Design, optimize, and maintain PostgreSQL schemas, including complex query authoring, indexing strategies, and PostGIS integration where geospatial data is involved.
● Implement standard authentication and authorization flows (JWT, OAuth2) and integrate with thirdparty services and data platforms.
● Write and maintain automated tests (Jest) across frontend and backend. Enforce code standards with ESLint and participate in CI/CD pipeline configuration.
● Work closely with dedicated frontend developers, backend engineers, data engineers, and business analysts to deliver complete, end-to-end features.
Required Qualifications
● 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with demonstrated full-stack delivery.
● Expert knowledge of Angular (standalone components, Signals) and TypeScript on the frontend. Strong RxJS proficiency for async and HTTP scenarios, with clear understanding of where Signals supersede RxJS-based state patterns.
● Solid proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript on the backend; experience with NestJS or a comparable enterprise-grade framework is strongly preferred.
● Strong working knowledge of PostgreSQL – schema design, query optimization, indexing, and transaction management.
● Comfortable authoring OpenAPI/Swagger documents as the leading contract artifact, driving frontend–backend alignment before implementation begins.
● Familiarity with micro-frontend patterns (Module Federation, Nx monorepos).
● Experience with automated testing (Jest) on both frontend and backend layers.
Nice-to-Have Skills
● Hands-on experience with PostGIS for spatial data processing and geographic queries.
● Cloud-native deployment experience, particularly on Microsoft Azure.
● Familiarity with Databricks for analytics integration or large-scale data pipeline consumption.
● Experience with real-time and inter-service communication patterns: SSE, gRPC, or WebSockets.
● Exposure to mapping libraries: Leaflet, OpenLayers, or Cesium.js.
Tech Stack: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx, Module Federation, Nx, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, PostGIS, TypeORM / Prisma, Jest, ESLint, OpenAPI / Swagger, Azure (preferred), Databricks (optional)

title: Integration & Enablement Engineer – AI Observability
description:
Are you a backend integration engineer eager to replace manual platform work with dependable automation that teams barely need to think about?
Join Camplight, where your expertise will help make AI observability a seamless part of how teams build and run products.
What you’ll be working on?
We are building an AI Observability platform for teams developing LLM applications and agents.
The goal is not simply to provide another tool for teams to configure. Observability should be created automatically when teams are provisioned with LLM credentials, granted model access, or deploy an agent. Projects, access, collection defaults, ownership metadata, retention, and redaction should be created through workflows teams already use.
The platform’s data must also flow into the wider engineering ecosystem. For example, an internal agent registry may need to display current evaluation results, while alerts and operational signals should reach the systems where teams work every day.
Your Role
Your role will involve building the integration layer between the AI Observability platform and the systems around it. You will create reliable integrations for automated provisioning, identity and access propagation, lifecycle management, evaluation-score publishing, alert delivery, and data exchange with internal systems. You will define and version data contracts so downstream consumers do not break when upstream systems change. You will design for real-world failure: retries, idempotency, backoff, backfills, reconciliation, drift detection, and monitoring of the integrations themselves. You will work closely with the Platform Engineer and Site Reliability Engineer, while owning the dependable automation that connects the platform with the wider engineering environment.
About Camplight
We build self-organizing technical teams, offer software development services, and work with businesses and entrepreneurs to create new products. With over 300 successful software projects, some ongoing for over 8 years, we strive for long-term success for our partners. By following the principles of self-management and organizing as a cooperative, we achieve 95% satisfaction among them. We seek the best talent to join us and value transparency, collaboration, trust, responsibility, and innovation. When joining Camplight, you can become a co-owner of the cooperative, allowing you to steer the business and share in the rewards of our collective success.
What are we looking for?
Ownership mindset: We want people who treat integrations as products with explicit guarantees, not one-off scripts that work only on a good day.
Technical expertise: You can build production-grade services, APIs, workflows, and automation with security, resilience, and maintainability in mind.
Systems thinking: You understand that every integration has lifecycle events, partial failures, versioning needs, and another team on the other side.
Communication skills: You can document contracts, clarify technical dependencies, and work effectively with different system owners and stakeholders.
Requirements
4+ years of backend, platform, or integration engineering experience.
Strong production experience in Python, TypeScript, or both.
Experience designing and consuming APIs, webhooks, event-driven services, queues, and authentication flows.
Experience defining, documenting, versioning, and evolving data contracts or schemas without breaking downstream consumers.
Strong identity and access integration experience, including OIDC or SSO, service accounts, API-key lifecycle, and mapping groups to roles and permissions.
Experience designing for failure: idempotency, retries, exponential backoff, partial-failure handling, backfills, and state reconciliation.
Experience monitoring integrations so failures are found proactively rather than reported by users.
CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code literacy.
Experience collaborating with multiple internal system owners and managing technical dependencies across teams.
Strong written and spoken English.
What do we offer?
We focus on health, wealth, and empowering relationships:
Fully remote work with flexible work hours
Competitive salary
Opportunity to become a co-owner of the cooperative
Individual career development plan
Friendly team and company culture
Prioritization of mental and physical health in the workplace, with the freedom to make decisions about oneself, supported by peers committed to a healthy lifestyle.
Empowering relationships for engineering alongside colleagues who cherish growth mindsets in a unique environment that blends service and product craftsmanship.
What does the interview process look like?
Initial Interview:
We’ll start with a friendly 45-minute cultural and technical interview. Two members of our team will assess your cultural fit, past experience, engineering expertise, the major challenges you’ve tackled, and discuss your ideal workspace.
You can choose between two Technical Deep Dive options:
Homework Assignment:
If there’s a match, we’ll provide a brief homework assignment designed to take around 2 hours to complete. This will be followed by a 1-hour technical interview to discuss the homework and conduct a technical deep dive.
Pair Programming:
If you prefer not to do a homework assignment, we’ll have a 2-hour technical deep dive session focused on a practical integration-design scenario.
Regardless of the outcome, we will provide you with constructive feedback to help you grow.

description:
At DIGITALL we don’t just deliver technology we deliver the future! We are explorers, knowledge-hunters, tech geeks, problem solvers and game changers who want to inspire and be inspired. Our DIGITALL people are always one step forward: working with top-notch technologies, creating innovations ahead of the market trends, sharing the passion for discovering better ways. As a human-centric organization, our teams are built on mutual respect and open communication, allowing everyone to be authentic, express ideas and unleash their potential. We are proud of our DIGITALL bright minds and never stop developing their skills to keep pushing boundaries together and do what we love. DIGITALL operates globally with a team of 1000 experts in 16 locations across 8 countries.
The department delivers innovative products and services to frontline staff working on over 6,000 projects throughout every Region and Global Practice. Our teams support and enable Bank priorities, boost operational efficiency and effectiveness, and facilitate Operational knowledge discovery. Our delivery model leverages global expertise, design and architecture, leading technology, and robust processes to deliver business solutions that ensure value for money.
Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Backend Developer to design, build, and maintain scalable, cloud-ready server-side applications and APIs. You will define system architecture with an API-first mindset, optimize data strategies using PostgreSQL, and deliver secure, production-grade RESTful and streaming services. Experience with NestJS, PostGIS, and Azure-native deployment patterns will set you apart.
Key Responsibilities
Architect and deploy robust, maintainable backend services using Node.js and TypeScript, with a preference for NestJS as the application framework.
Author the OpenAPI/Swagger specification as the primary design artifact before any implementation begins, using it as the contract between frontend and backend teams. RESTful services, streaming patterns (SSE, chunked transfer), and any inter-service interfaces are all derived from and validated against this spec.
Own schema design, complex query authoring, and performance tuning for PostgreSQL, including indexing strategies, partitioning, and transaction management, using modern ORMs or query builders (Prisma, TypeORM).
Implement spatial indexing and queries using PostGIS to store, process, and serve geospatial information efficiently.
Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms (JWT, OAuth2) and caching strategies (Redis).
Design and deploy services for cloud-native environments with a preference for Microsoft Azure (Azure App Services, Azure Container Apps, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure API Management, Azure Service Bus).
Quality & Ops: Maintain automated testing suites (Jest, Supertest) and participate in CI/CD pipeline configuration.
Required Qualifications
5+ years of server-side software engineering experience.
Advanced proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript.
Deep practical knowledge of PostgreSQL – query optimization, indexing, partitioning, and transaction management.
Proven experience authoring OpenAPI/Swagger documents as the leading design artifact – contract first, implementation second.
Proven track record of designing and maintaining production-grade REST APIs, including streaming response patterns (SSE, chunked transfer encoding).
Experience with unit and integration testing frameworks (Jest, Supertest).
Strong grasp of software engineering fundamentals (SOLID principles, clean architecture, design patterns).
Nice-to-Have Skills
Professional experience with NestJS or a comparable enterprise-grade Node.js framework.
Hands-on experience with PostGIS for spatial data processing and geographic queries.
Cloud-native deployment experience on Microsoft Azure (Azure App Services, Azure Container Apps,
Azure Functions, Azure API Management).
Experience with gRPC for high-performance, contract-first inter-service communication.
Familiarity with caching layers (Redis) and message brokers (Azure Service Bus).
Exposure to Databricks for large-scale data processing and analytics pipeline integration.
Tech Stack: Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL, PostGIS, TypeORM / Prisma, Jest, OpenAPI / Swagger, REST, SSE, Azure.
Organizational information:
All applications will be treated in strict confidentiality
Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview

description:
Xebia
is a global AI-first, digital transformation, and engineering partner. With over 25 years of experience and a team of 5,000 professionals across 16 countries, we help organizations design and build scalable products, platforms, and data-driven solutions.
We specialize in Artificial Intelligence, Data and Cloud, Intelligent Automation, and Digital Products, combining deep technical expertise with a strong focus on engineering excellence and a people-first culture.
In the CEE region, we’re a team of nearly 1,000 experts delivering modern applications, data platforms, and AI solutions for clients such as Millennium, ING, Play, Edenred, Arabian Drilling, FedEx, Leroy Merlin, Truecaller, Volotea, Schmitz Cargobull, and many, many more. We work with leading technologies including AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, and Snowflake, and combine strong engineering culture with a consulting mindset and a continuous focus on growth and knowledge sharing.
About project:
We are looking for a
Senior React / TypeScript Frontend Engineer
to join a project delivered for a leading international transportation company specializing in railcar leasing, maintenance, and telematics services. With more than 125 years of international experience, the company operates across more than 20 countries and manages a large fleet of modern tank and freight railcars.
This role is focused on developing and evolving modern, business-critical web applications using a contemporary React and TypeScript technology stack. You will be working with a modern frontend architecture built around React, Nx, Vite, and a strong focus on quality, testing, maintainability, and developer experience.
You will be:
developing modern frontend applications using TypeScript and the latest version of React with React Compiler,
building and maintaining applications within an Nx monorepo,
developing reusable UI components and frontend architecture using React and MUI,
implementing responsive and maintainable styling using Emotion,
building and maintaining reusable components and documenting them through Storybook,
developing forms using React Hook Form and implementing schema validation with Zod or Superstruct,
managing application state and data fetching using Zustand and TanStack Query,
developing and maintaining unit and integration tests using Vitest and React Testing Library,
implementing end-to-end tests using Playwright,
ensuring code quality and consistency through ESLint, Prettier, Husky, Commitizen, and Commitlint,
working with Vite as the module bundler and pnpm as the package manager,
implementing logging and application monitoring using CloudWatch RUM,
collaborating with other engineers and stakeholders to deliver maintainable and scalable frontend solutions,
applying AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Claude throughout planning, implementation, code review, and testing,
evaluating different AI models based on their capabilities, cost, and suitability for specific development tasks,
applying knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) and identifying relevant use cases for AI-assisted development,
contributing to frontend best practices, code reviews, testing, and continuous improvement.
Your profile:
strong professional experience with TypeScript and React,
hands-on experience building production-grade frontend applications,
strong understanding of modern React development and component-based architecture,
experience working with Nx and monorepo-based frontend projects,
experience with modern frontend build tools such as Vite,
experience with component libraries such as MUI and styling solutions such as Emotion,
experience with React Hook Form and schema validation libraries such as Zod or Superstruct,
solid understanding of frontend state management and data fetching, preferably with Zustand and TanStack Query,
strong experience with frontend testing, including unit and integration testing with Vitest and React Testing Library,
hands-on experience with Playwright or another modern E2E testing framework,
understanding of frontend code quality and development tooling such as ESLint, Prettier, Husky, and Commitlint,
experience with Git and modern software development workflows,
strong understanding of frontend performance, maintainability, and scalability,
ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with other engineers and stakeholders.
practical experience using AI-powered assistants (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to improve productivity, quality, or decision-making in software delivery.
Work from the European Union region and a work permit are required
.
Nice to have:
hands-on experience with React Compiler,
experience developing and maintaining component libraries with Storybook,
experience with CloudWatch RUM or similar frontend observability solutions,
practical experience with AI-assisted development using Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Claude,
knowledge of MCP and AI-assisted engineering workflows,
experience evaluating and selecting AI models based on cost, capabilities, and use case,
experience working in large-scale Nx monorepos,
experience with modern frontend architecture and design systems.
experience applying GenAI in a more structured way within the SDLC, including defined workflows, prompt patterns, or tool integrations embedded into daily work.
interest in and familiarity with emerging AI-driven practices (e.g. agent-based workflows, automation patterns, AI-augmented development), with a willingness to explore and experiment beyond standard approaches.

title: Fullstack Engineer with experience in building API & MCP
description:
If you want to build the interface other people’s AI agents depend on, not just another dashboard, keep reading.
About GetHookd
GetHookd.ai is an ad intelligence platform used by 5,500+ eCommerce and marketing teams to find and create winning ad creatives. We maintain a searchable library of 100+ million ads across Meta and TikTok, adding tens of thousands daily through a scraper fleet that runs 24/7. Semantic search over the whole thing. A data moat that grows every hour we stay online.
In July we launched our API and MCP server. AI agents now query our platform programmatically, and it’s our fastest-growing usage channel. Some of our most active users have never seen our UI. They’re Claude, Cursor, and custom agents built by teams we’ve never spoken to.
GetHookd is built and run by Meliora, a product studio in Sofia with two Shopify app exits behind us. GetHookd is our current focus and our biggest bet. A startup team with a studio’s track record, profitable, no outside funding, allergic to bureaucracy.
The Role
Straight version: the API and MCP server shipped fast because they had to. They work, people use them, and usage is outgrowing the first version. We’re hiring you to own that surface and make it the best way to access ad intelligence anywhere, for humans and for agents.
You’ll work across the stack: API design, MCP tools, auth and rate limiting, docs, SDKs, and the parts of the web app where developers sign up, get keys, and understand what they’re paying for.
The stack: PHP, Laravel, Python, Node.js, React.js, TypeSense-powered semantic search, GCP (GKE) with Cloudflare at the edge, GitHub Actions, and a product team shipping daily.
What You’ll Own
The public API: endpoint design, versioning, pagination, error contracts, etc.
The MCP server: tool design, descriptions, schemas, and response shapes that an LLM can actually use correctly on the first try
Documentation that’s accurate because it’s generated from or tested against the real thing
Auth, API keys, scopes, rate limits, and usage metering tied to billing
Observability for the API channel: who’s calling what, what fails, where agents get confused, and what that tells us about the product
Fullstack features that support the platform:
A feedback loop between API usage data and the product roadmap
Who We’re Looking For
5+ years building production web applications across backend and frontend
You’ve designed and shipped a public or partner-facing API that other developers depended on, and you’ve lived with its mistakes
Hands-on experience building MCP servers, LLM tool integrations, or agent-facing interfaces is a strong plus. If you’ve watched a model misread your tool description and fixed it, we want to hear about it.
Strong opinions on REST, OpenAPI, and error design, loosely held
Comfortable with auth flows, rate limiting, caching, and the unglamorous parts of running an API in production
Experience with search-heavy products (TypeSense, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch) is a plus
You write docs as part of the feature, not after it
You use AI coding tools daily and know exactly where they fall over
You design for the caller who will misuse your API, including an agent that takes your error messages literally. We will ask about this in the interview.
This Role Is Not For You If
You want to stay on one side of the stack
You think developer experience means a nice docs theme
Breaking changes are someone else’s problem
You need a spec before you can start. Often you’ll be writing it.
You want to rewrite the API in month one. It has scars, but it has paying users.
What We Offer
Hybrid: week 1 in-office, then Mon–Wed office / Thu–Fri remote
20+ days paid leave, growing with tenure
Private health insurance and an optional sports card
Real product ownership. No red tape. No fluff.
A small, honest team that ships things that matter
How We Work
No Black Boxes. Share context early, often, and publicly.
Feed Forward. Feedback is fast, clear, and focused on what’s next.
Own the Outcome. We finish the job, not the task.
Hack a Better Way. Prototype, test, adapt.
Flex & Flow. Plans change, we move.
The Process
Four steps, two weeks total:
a short written screen (3 questions, 20 minutes)
a technical conversation including a review of a real endpoint or MCP tool from our codebase
a paid 3-hour practical
and a founder conversation.
Happy to hear from you!

title: Full Stack Engineer

Join Camplight and contribute to building modern, scalable web applications that deliver real impact through clean architecture and intuitive design.

The platform emphasizes modular microservices architecture, enabling efficient data flow and seamless integration between systems. You’ll play a key role in crafting user-friendly interfaces while ensuring strong connectivity with backend services via RESTful APIs. You’ll be responsible for building responsive interfaces, connecting them to microservices, and ensuring smooth communication across the system. Your day-to-day will involve collaborating with designers, reviewing code, troubleshooting issues, and continuously improving the product’s performance and user experience. A strong understanding of modern web architecture, APIs, and authentication mechanisms will be essential.
About Camplight
We build self-organizing technical teams, offer software development services, and work with businesses and entrepreneurs to create new products. With over 300 successful software projects, some ongoing for over 8 years, we strive for long-term success for our partners. By following the principles of self-management and organizing as a cooperative, we achieve 95% satisfaction among them. We seek the best talent to join us and value transparency, collaboration, trust, responsibility, and innovation. When joining Camplight, you can become a co-owner of the cooperative, allowing you to steer the business and share in the rewards of our collective success.
What are we looking for?
Ownership mindset: We value professionals who take pride in their work, uphold high standards, and consistently deliver quality results.
Technical expertise: Strong command of modern web development, with the ability to build scalable, maintainable applications.
Communication skills: Clear and effective communication is essential when collaborating with partners and teammates. Strong English, emotional intelligence, and the ability to manage expectations are key.
Requirements
5+ years of experience as a Full Stack Developer or similar role
Strong proficiency in AngularJS and its core principles
Experience designing and working with microservices architecture
Solid experience with RESTful APIs and web service integration
Familiarity with OpenAPI specification and SwaggerUI
Understanding of authentication and authorization (OAuth2, JWT)
Experience with version control systems such as Git
Understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe)
What do we offer?
We focus on health, wealth, and empowering relationships:
Fully remote work with flexible work hours
Competitive salary
Opportunity to become a co-owner of the cooperative
Individual career development plan
Friendly team and company culture
Prioritization of mental and physical health in the workplace
Empowering relationships with colleagues who value growth and craftsmanship

A 45-minute cultural and technical conversation with two team members to explore your experience, mindset, and expectations.
You can choose between two Technical Deep Dive options:
Homework Assignment:
A short task (~2 hours), followed by a 1-hour discussion and technical deep dive.
Pair Programming:
A 2-hour live session focused on collaboration and problem-solving.
Regardless of the outcome, we provide constructive feedback to support your growth.

title: Head of AI Engineering (f/m/x)
description:
Your mission
Own and evolve our AI engineering function — transforming a 15–20 person ML team from research-heavy to a high-throughput, production-grade organization. You’ll partner with the CTO on strategy, build the platform that unifies LLM access, RAG, and backend services, and ship reliable, scalable AI features that change how banks work.
Key responsibilities
• Team leadership and org build
o Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team; set the technical bar, operating rhythms, and code/research review practices
o Organize sub-teams (e.g., Core Modeling, AI Platform/Infra, Integrations) with clear ownership, SLOs, andon-call
o Manage roadmap, capacity planning, and delivery across parallel initiatives
• Architecture and platform
o Own the LLM gateway: unified APIs and proxy layers for multi-provider routing (OpenAI, Gemini, Bedrock), with rate limits, fallbacks, and cost tracking
o Build high-performance RAG pipelines (ingestion, embeddings, vector stores, caching) with robust observability and safety guardrails
o Partner with Java/NestJSteams to define clean async contracts, schemas, and eventing patterns; drive low-latency, scalable inference

o Lead end-to-end model and prompt lifecycle: data curation, training/fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment, rollback
o Establish LLMOps/MLOps: model/prompt registries, CI/CD, canary/A/B tests, offline/online evals, drift and cost monitoring
o Optimizeinference throughput and cost (autoscaling, batching, quantization/distillation, caching)
• Strategy and collaboration
o Translate company goals into an AI/ML roadmap with measurable outcomes; balance exploration with reliability and cost
o Own build-vs-buy/vendor strategy for models, infrastructure, and data services; manage budgets and SLAs
• Governance and security
o Implement data privacy, security, and compliance practices (RBAC, secrets, auditability); track prompt/model lineage and reproducibility
o Define incident response, runbooks, and postmortems for AI features
Your profile
• 5+ years as a backend engineer and 4+ years leading AI/ML engineering in production (10+ years total experience ideal)
• Deep architecture expertise in Java (JVM) and/or Node.js (NestJS), distributed systems, APIs, microservices, and messaging/streaming
• Hands-on with LLM stacks: orchestration (e.g.,LangChain/LlamaIndexor custom), vector DBs (Pinecone,Qdrant, FAISS), cloud AI (e.g., AWS Bedrock)
• Proven operation of systems at scale (millions of daily API calls) with strong SLOs, observability, and incident management
• MLOpsfoundations: model registries, experiment tracking, CI/CD, Kubernetes,IaC(e.g., Terraform), security best practices
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management; strong product sense focused on shipping user-facing feature
Nice to have
• Experience with GPU/accelerator serving and optimization (vLLM, TGI, Triton, ONNX Runtime)
• Cost optimization for LLM workloads (token budgets, dynamic routing, caching)
• Evaluation and safety/red-teaming for generative systems; startup/high-growth experience
Impact metrics
• Platform: adoption of a unified LLM gateway; standardized observability and cost reporting
• Delivery: 2–3 user-facing AI features shipped with clear SLOs and measurable impact
• Reliability/cost: reduced average latency and cost per request; autoscaling and caching in place
• Org: sub-team structureestablished; improved code quality and on-time delivery; targeted hiring completed
Our stack
• Backend: Java (JVM), Node.js (NestJS); event-driven microservices; API gateways/proxies
• AI platform: Python,PyTorch, LLM orchestration, prompt pipelines/registry; vector DBs (Pinecone,Qdrant); RAG services
• Infra/DevOps: AWS (incl. Bedrock), Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, Observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana)
Why us
• Because we value talent more than hierarchy.
• Because at neoshare, responsibility isn’t delegated – it’s owned.
• Because we use modern AI and technology as a lever for exceptional results.
• Because we develop people who want to learn, grow, and deliver.
• Because performance, quality, and impact belong together for us.
• Because we are working together towards building a European tech champion.
What You Can Expect
• Performance-driven, above-average compensation that rewards outstanding commitment.
• High-end offices designed to support collaboration, wellbeing, and peak performance – including great health and fitness benefits.
• Legendary team events where we celebrate our wins together and strengthen team spirit.
• State-of-the-art AI tools, first-class equipment, and an environment that fosters ownership and personal growth.
• Concentration of top talent, fast decision-making, and the chance to make a real impact early on.

title: Manager, Quality Engineering
description:
Job Description
Title: Manager, Quality Engineering
Reporting to: Sr Director, Quality Engineering
Location: Remote, Bulgaria
Department: Quality Engineering
About Quickbase
At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.
For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off-the-shelf software wasn’t built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.
Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.
About the Role
As a Quality Engineering Manager, you will own the quality strategy for a significant product domain while leading a talented team of Quality Engineers supporting multiple engineering teams. Through your partnership with other Quality Engineering (QE) leaders, you’ll help shape and evolve our quality tooling and practices and continue to build a culture where quality is a shared responsibility.
Our teams support quality efforts across multiple product domains, invest heavily in automation, and embrace AI-assisted development. This role requires technical judgement, strong people leadership, and the ability to build trust across teams.
Success in this role is measured by the quality of the software your team helps deliver, the growth of the quality engineers you lead, and your ability to influence how quality is built into the software development lifecycle.
What You’ll Do
Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6–10 Quality Engineers supporting multiple engineering teams and product initiatives.
Own the quality strategy for a product domain by partnering closely with other leaders, tech leads, and product managers to improve software quality, delivery predictability, and customer outcomes.
Provides technical and architectural leadership in test automation, frameworks, CI/CD, and testing standards.
Partner with QE leadership to define and evolve scalable quality practices and AI-assisted testing solutions, translate those into clear team priorities and goals, and drive consistent adoption to improve quality outcomes
Balance competing priorities across multiple engineering teams, helping stakeholders understand tradeoffs while ensuring the highest-value work receives appropriate quality investment.
Coach and mentor through clear, actionable feedback – developing technical and leadership capabilities, clarifying promotion expectations, and supporting career growth.
Lead teams through ambiguity, changing priorities, and organizational change while maintaining focus, engagement, and delivery excellence.
Influence engineering teams to build quality earlier in the software development lifecycle through collaboration, data, and thoughtful decision-making.
About You
You believe quality engineering is much more than finding defects — it’s a shared engineering responsibility woven into how software gets built. You also lead by helping others do their best work, and you measure your own success by theirs.
You will be successful in this role if you:
Build trust quickly with your team and other leaders and teams in the organization.
Lead with curiosity, active listening, empathy, and thoughtful communication.
Make informed decisions in an environment where priorities can change or information is incomplete.
Balance customer needs, quality, delivery timelines, and business priorities when making tradeoffs
Create an inclusive, collaborative environment where individuals feel empowered to learn, experiment, and continuously improve.
Believe your success is a reflection of the success, engagement, and growth of your team.
Experience We Think You’ll Need
Demonstrated success managing and developing a high-performing Quality Engineering team.
Experience with or working knowledge of AI-assisted software development; including AI assisted test generation, model evaluation, and skills/playbooks.
Experience developing and scaling quality processes that drive greater efficiency and support organizational growth.
Experience leading and working with distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones.
Understanding of fundamental quality engineering strategies and practices.
Demonstrated ability to influence decisions on teams without direct authority.
Why Quickbase?
At Quickbase, Quality Engineering is a strategic partner in how software is built and this role carries real scope: you’ll help shape and evolve our quality strategy not just execute someone else’s plan.

Define and operate Xebia’s cybersecurity capability across prevention, detection, response and recovery.

Evaluate and implement security technologies and controls that effectively address identified risks.

Define and enforce security guardrails for agentic AI, including least-privilege access, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, action logging, audit trails and containment controls.
Assess risks related to third-party foundation models, plugins, MCP servers and agent frameworks.
Maintain an inventory of AI models and agents in use across the business and assess their security exposure.
Partner with AI/ML Engineering and platform teams to enable secure adoption of AI-assisted and agentic coding, delivery and client-facing tools.
Help Xebia continuously adapt its security approach to the rapidly evolving AI threat landscape.

Ensure critical systems and services can be restored within agreed RTO/RPO objectives.
Drive ransomware resilience through immutable and segmented backups, isolated recovery environments and tested recovery playbooks.
Lead regular cyber crisis, business continuity and recovery exercises.
Own protection of Xebia’s and clients’ intellectual property, source code, proprietary methodologies, AI models, training data and confidential client deliverables.
Drive DLP, access controls, code repository security and exfiltration monitoring.
Partner with HR and Legal to manage insider risk throughout the employee and contractor lifecycle.
Security Programme & Transformation Leadership:
Own and continuously evolve Xebia’s global cybersecurity transformation roadmap.
Translate identified risks into concrete technology, process and programme initiatives.
Lead cybersecurity programmes from definition through implementation, ensuring clear milestones, ownership and measurable outcomes.
Build business cases and contribute to investment decisions around cybersecurity tooling, capabilities and team growth.
Establish practical, measurable and enforceable security controls across the organisation.
Build and develop a global cybersecurity team as the function grows.
Work effectively with distributed teams and external security partners.

Cybersecurity at Xebia is also a
business and revenue enabler
.

Support customer security questionnaires, audits and assurance activities.
Anticipate customer security expectations and translate them into practical security capabilities.
Contribute to strategic sales opportunities and client engagements.
Help position Xebia as a trusted technology and security partner.
Balance security requirements with business and customer needs, finding pragmatic solutions rather than simply applying rigid controls.

Communicate complex cybersecurity risks in clear business terms.
Maintain a risk-based cybersecurity transformation roadmap with quarterly milestones.
Manage third-party, vendor and software/AI supply chain cyber risk.
Own the execution of the security awareness programme, including phishing simulations, role-based training and insider risk culture.
Support customer security assurance activities, audits, certifications and M&A cyber due diligence.
Work with IT GRC & Assurance and Legal to ensure operational controls meet relevant regulatory obligations, including GDPR, NIS2, DORA and client contractual requirements.

Senior cybersecurity leader with deep operational security, cloud, identity and incident response experience, typically 12+ years in security with 5+ years in a leadership role.
Track record running or transforming a SOC/detection function and leading enterprise-scale incident response and crisis management.
Practical experience securing multi-cloud and modern application environments, plus AI models and agentic AI systems — model risk, prompt-level attacks and permissioning/containment of autonomous agents — given Xebia’s AI-led business.
Experience owning business continuity/disaster recovery planning and data loss prevention or IP protection programmes in a technology or professional services setting.
Able to balance pragmatic delivery with risk reduction and customer assurance.
Credible with executives, auditors, customers and technical teams; comfortable presenting cyber risk in business terms to the Board.
Experience leading distributed, multicultural teams across regions.
Certifications & knowledge
Indicative certifications include:
CISSP
CISM
GCIH
GCFA
CCSP
OSCP
Certifications are not the only measure of expertise — practical experience and the ability to implement and lead are critical.
Working familiarity with:
NIST CSF 2.0
ISO 27001
MITRE ATT&CK
GDPR
NIS2
DORA
OWASP LLM Top 10
OWASP Agentic AI threats
MITRE ATLAS
or equivalent hands-on exposure to securing AI models and autonomous agents.

Strong hands-on technical depth.
Cybersecurity programme and transformation leadership.
Modern cloud and identity security expertise.
Practical AI/LLM and agentic AI security experience.
Strong customer orientation.
Excellent communication and leadership presence.
The ability to operate effectively in a global, distributed environment

global role based in Europe

Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or other relevant certifications preferred.
Minimum of 6+ years in cybersecurity engineering, systems administration, or platform operations, with at least 2+ years of experience leading or managing technical engineering teams.
Proven hands-on administration expertise across multiple enterprise security technologies:
SIEM/Data Lake: Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or Elastic (data parsing, pipeline management, index strategy).
Endpoint Protection: CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (policy tuning, sensor deployment, exclusions).
Cloud Security (CNAPP/CSPM): Prisma Cloud, Wiz, or Orca Security.
Strong familiarity with automating administrative tasks using Python, PowerShell, or Bash, and managing configurations via CI/CD pipelines and IaC (Terraform, Ansible).
Systems Administration: Deep foundational knowledge of enterprise operating systems (Windows Server, RedHat/Ubuntu Linux), Active Directory/Entra ID, and cloud infrastructure architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex system health metrics into clear business-risk conversations.
Strong cooperative approach with a track record of building trusted relationships with downstream security consumers (Security Analysts, IR Teams, Threat Hunters).

title: Technical Manager
description:
Role Summary:
The Professional Services team is a team that works closely with Sales to jointly develop and support viable plans for delivering industry leading solutions on top of standard services and delivering in life support of GTT Enterprise customers. GTT’s Technical Management offering is a consultative, value-add professional services that provides a tailored experience to their client base.
As a Technical Manager you will own the technical integrity of a customer solution, understand the wider context of the solution with the customer and how it aligns with their business, bringing a holistic ITIL based Service Management structure to some of GTT’s most important Managed Customers.
At any one time you will work on multiple client accounts and must have the ability to develop and present client solutions to leadership and technical teams. The Technical Manager is an expert in the (software defined) networking area (Velocloud, Aruba Silverpeak and Fortinet) and in the security area (Palo Alto and Fortinet).
In addition, the Technical Manager will be required to lead and assess risks imposed by technical solutions and advise clients of security standards, best practice, and solutions to address any risk and you will be required to contribute technical responses to RFI and RFPs and to assist customers with security and network audits.
Duties and Responsibilities:
Delivering Professional Services engagements in-line with an agreed scope to the acceptance of the client.
Enhancing the client experience by displaying flexibility, technical excellence, agility, ownership, and responsibility.
Becoming an invaluable partner to the client.
Monitor industry networking updates, technologies, and best practices to improve overall network management and to remain informed of new technical developments and trends in the industry.
Own the customer solution lifecycle from initial customer order onwards, highlighting and managing risks, issues, and the changing requirements of the solution as needed.
Ensuring that the customer solution is accurately recorded in systems and documentation.
Assisting in the creation of service reports and attending regular service review meeting as and when required.
Be the customers advocate in all technical matters related to their solution.
Act as a primary technical interface to customers for addressing high level concerns on operational performance and for interpreting their change requirements into standard orders or where unavoidable creating customer specific environments to satisfy such requirement.
The Technical Manager needs to be able to understand the business processes of our customers and transform them into services based on GTT’s infrastructure and service catalogue.
Act as (security) technical escalation for the central incident management team
Ensuring that the services we deliver meet the agreed service levels and that we have the necessary IT service management processes OLA’s and contracts with 3rd parties in place.
Regular attendance at customer locations.
International travel may be required.
Required experience/qualifications
Minimum 5 years’ experience in the Telco or Managed Service Provider industry.
Experience working autonomously in a multi-vendor enterprise scale environment.
Working knowledge and/or general understanding of ICT methodologies such as ITIL
Experience working with firewalls from vendors like Palo Alto and/or Fortinet.
Knowledge and working experience in:
Routing on various platform with MPLS, BGP, QOS etc
Next-Gen Security and Cloud Security (based on Palo Alto, Fortinet)
Experience creating architectural building blocks from business requirements.
Understanding of the financial impact of strategic / operational decisions and the ability to identify opportunity for cost reductions.
Desirable experience/qualifications
SD-Wan technologies (preferred HPE Aruba/Silver Peak, VeloCloud, Fortinet. Others like Versa, Viptela, Cato)
Cisco and / or Juniper expert level experience in routing and switching
Cloud Security (Zscaler, Cisco Umbrella…)
Knowledge and Working experience with :
SASE / SSE solutions from any vendor
Advanced security features (DLP, CASB, Sandboxing,)
Endpoint Protection (XDR)
Vulnerability management
Experience with Cloud providers like Azure, AWS, and Google
Experience of working on major international and global accounts.
